verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an FP&A SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes live data syncing and auto-updating reports ("Actuals flow in, the narrative updates, the deck builds itself"). That is an adjacent automation behavior, not a documented capability for users to define and schedule recurring jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
